title: Webapp/mobile for converting rambling voice to text, and something to draw menu mockups?
author: Anxious-Individual40
selftext:
I want to brainstorm the menus and game screens / UI for my game.

Are there webapps/mobile apps to help? (pref. not a brand new vibe coded personal project.)

I want to voice dictate notes, and sketch each screen with details, and then export this in pretty much any format, to use in other AIs for further development. 

If I was doing this manually I would have a bunch of sheets of paper with a menu or game screen on each page with a column for notes somewhere. I want to do that, digitally.

My real speech is not clear at all and I usually need to ramble a bit to get the point and idea across, so the voice part would need to have some AI element to convert the ramble into notes.

Thank you!

You know, now that I write this out, I bet I could turn this into a PRD or something and have claude make it for me. Any suggestions other than doing it myself?
